# MD Shahed

> MD Shahed (also written as Md Shahed, MD SHAHED, Shahed, or শাহেদ) is a Dhaka, Bangladesh-based web developer, entrepreneur, and digital creator.

MD Shahed specializes in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, SEO, branding, e-commerce, and scalable web applications focused on business growth and modern digital experiences.

Md Shahed combines technology, branding, and business strategy to build impactful, performance-driven digital solutions for startups, SMEs, and enterprises — locally in Dhaka, Bangladesh and globally.

## Identity

- Official website: https://shahed.com.bd
- Name variants: MD Shahed; Md Shahed; MD SHAHED; Shahed; শাহেদ
- Role: Web Developer & Entrepreneur
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Primary topics: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, SEO, e-commerce, branding, and digital consulting
